audience: legal and operations teams that draft and track contracts from templates in Juro

useCases.title: Review the templates and their questions
useCases.text: List the contract templates with their status and IDs. Open one to read its questions before you create a contract from it.

useCases.title: Find contracts updated recently
useCases.text: List the contracts updated since a date. Open one to read its status, answers, signing sides and approval state.

useCases.title: Create a draft contract from a template
useCases.text: Read the template questions, then create a draft contract with the answers. Nothing is sent to anyone, and no signing link goes out.

useCases.title: Rename a contract or fill in its fields
useCases.text: Read the contract, then change its name or field values. On a signed contract, only fields can change.
